_source: Sunken Kingdom Gear (owner scan 2026-11-03, one of each shown; copies assumed 2 like Principality [확인 필요])

gear.name: Ancient Totem
gear.text:
When moving through a Swamp Terrain tile, you may re-roll the [d10] rolled on the Swamp effect (once).
2 [Heat] [Discard] Ignore a Rotation.
[GRAVE] 2 [Heat] [Discard] Lifeline.

gear.name: Gladiator Armguard
gear.text:
+1 Might [Might].
2 [Heat] [Exhaust] Ignore Unwieldy on your Weapons until the end of your turn.
unclear: 트레잇에 Armor가 있지만 슬롯 아이콘은 Support(주머니)

gear.name: Fragrant Herbs
gear.text:
[Exhaust] Lose up to -3 [Vigor] to lose the same amount of [Heat] (minimum 1). Then, discard up to 2 Poison tokens.
[MAJOR] Adjacent Knights may use this card's ability as a free action (they still need to pay its cost).

gates.text: Adjacent Knights may use this card's ability as a free action (they still need to pay its cost).

gear.name: Firenzance Oil Lamp
gear.text:
2 [Heat] [Exhaust] Trailmake 3, then place 1 Fire [Fire] token in the Knight Pool.
1 [Heat] [Exhaust] Move 1 space.

gear.name: Silverine Solution
gear.text:
Poison Limit +2.
You may gain 1 Bane [Bane] token to ignore the effects of 1 Condition card until the end of your turn.
Start of your turn: Bane 1.

gear.name: Oozeboots
gear.text:
+1 Speed [Speed].
You may use your [Combat action] as a [Move action].
unclear: 두 행동 아이콘을 전투 행동 → 이동 행동 순으로 판독

gear.name: Wastewood Camo
gear.text:
Poison Resilience 1.
Hide. Daze.
1 [Heat] During Delve, you may move through Shortcuts.
unclear: 우상단 +2 아이콘을 Evasion bonus로 판독; 슬롯 아이콘 = Armor

gear.name: Reactive Underarmor
gear.text:
[Reaction] 2 [Heat] [Exhaust] Move up to X* spaces. Use this ability only during a Monster Attack, after an Evasion Roll.
*X is the amount of Evasion dice you rolled during this Attack.

gear.name: Divine Distillate
gear.text:
1 [Heat] [Exhaust] After drawing a Judicium, resolve the opposite Judicium. You must use this ability before performing the draw.
[PASSION 3+] 2 [Heat] [Discard] Draw a Judicium. If you survive, return a chosen Knight to life adjacent to you (do not reset their [Vigor]).

gates.text: 2 [Heat] [Discard] Draw a Judicium. If you survive, return a chosen Knight to life adjacent to you (do not reset their [Vigor]).

gear.name: Ever-Sinking Stilts
gear.text:
2 [Heat] [Exhaust] During movement, ignore all Terrain tiles.
[GRAVE] [Discard] Destroy an adjacent Destructible Terrain tile.

gates.text: [Discard] Destroy an adjacent Destructible Terrain tile.

gear.name: Gardener-Alchemist's Talisman
gear.text:
Poison Resilience 2.
Start of your turn: Lose -1 [Vigor].
You may pay with [Vigor] to re-roll your dice instead of [Heat].
[PASSION 5+] [Discard] Reset your [Vigor].

gear.name: Cat Eye Glasses
gear.text:
+1 Insight [Insight]. Closing 1.
Ignore Obscuring.
[MAJOR] [Discard] When you attack with a Ranged Weapon, double its maximum range for this Attack.

gates.text: [Discard] When you attack with a Ranged Weapon, double its maximum range for this Attack.

gear.name: Gorilla Grip Charm
gear.text:
If you're using [2 hands] Weapons, they lose Cumbersome, Unwieldy, and Commit.
[GRAVE] Once per Clash, immediately perform a Bonus Attack, then suffer Knockdown.

gates.text: Once per Clash, immediately perform a Bonus Attack, then suffer Knockdown.

gear.name: Royal Luxblossom
gear.text:
1 [Charge] 1 [Heat] Gain +6 [Vigor].
1 [Heat] [Discard] Perform Rotation 1.
End of your turn: If this card has no [Charge], lose -1 [Vigor].
[GRAVE] 1 [Heat] [Discard] Gain a permanent positive Precision [Precision] token.

gates.text: 1 [Heat] [Discard] Gain a permanent positive Precision [Precision] token.
